arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_over_500_credit FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions over $500 made with credit cards, the same measure as the prepaid count.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, as in the earlier prepaid query.
Negative amounts are excluded by the over-$500 condition, as in the earlier query.
The period is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
